title: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.11153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. translated_title: CARE：基于师生蒸馏的约束注意力精炼方法用于细粒度视觉分类
translated_abstract: 细粒度视觉分类要求模型在识别细微局部特征的同时，揭示其预测背后的视觉证据。类别特定的注意力路径为可解释识别提供了天然基础，但其受限的预测结构限制了判别能力，且未能充分利用强大预训练骨干网络的中间层表示。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CARE，一个通过师生蒸馏实现可解释细粒度识别的约束注意力精炼框架。CARE将最终预测与解释保持在类别特定的注意力学生网络中，同时引入一个仅在训练阶段使用的辅助查询教师网络，该教师通过可学习查询读取DINOv2选定的中间层。教师网络融合多层级表示，并将经logit标准化的类判别性知识传递给学生网络。为进一步精炼解释路径，我们设计了（摘要内容不完整，此处原文截断）
tldr: CARE提出了一种师生蒸馏框架，借助仅在训练时使用的查询教师融合DINOv2的多层表示并将判别性知识传递给类别特定的注意力学生网络，从而在保持可解释性的同时提升细粒度视觉分类的判别能力。
en_tdlr: CARE is a teacher-student distillation framework that uses a training-only query teacher to fuse multi-level DINOv2 representations and transfer class-discriminative knowledge to a class-specific attention student, boosting fine-grained visual classification performance while preserving interpretability.
